open_threads: (1) Akien's correction 2026-10-17, in caps: harbor_master is a reporting system and nothing more. It reports where everything is. The gates are only housed in it ('because we had to have some place to put them, but it does not control anything'), and they refuse on the ticket's behalf. Never describe a PROVED crossing as harbor_master deciding. Recorded in CC memory harbor-master-only-reports.md and passed to builder. (2) There is no CLI to raise a trouble ('there is no raise subcommand', bin/cairn trouble); CC could not raise the deadlock as a trouble from a shell, so it went straight to a ticket. (3) Akien asked for a component outline (devices, machines, tools, commands) and got it in chat; it is not filed. `cairn cairn` prints no commands of its own. (4) Rehearsal gaps were partly new on each pass (5 passes, about $0.65 each); the readers ask different questions each time.
